verdict.rationale: Granola documents a first-party Zapier integration connecting notes to 8,000+ apps, and Granola Chat can draft and send Slack messages with a review step. Notion only appears as a use case for building on the Granola API, which is a developer building block rather than a native integration. missing for 10: native Notion page sync, automatic posting of notes to Slack channels (beyond chat-drafted messages with review), independent or hands-on corroboration of the Zapier and Slack flows.

support.subject: As a product manager, notes flow into the tools where work happens — Slack channels, Notion pages, and thousands of apps via Zapier

citations.quote: Connect Granola to 8,000+ apps and automate what happens after a meeting
Use Granola Chat to draft follow-up emails, send Slack messages, and schedule Google Calendar events — with a review step before anything is sent or created.
draft and send a Slack message
